newsitem.title: FRANCE: TENNIS-HIGHLIGHTS OF THE DAY AT ROLAND GARROS.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-HIGHLIGHTS OF THE DAY AT ROLAND GARROS.

text.p: A brief selection of highlights from the second day of the French Open on Tuesday:

Best quote - "It was a bad match, but the sun's going to rise tomorrow and I'll be on a plane following it." Jim Courier looks on the bright side after his first round defeat to Sweden's Magnus Larsson.
Stat of the day - Zero. The number of sets dropped by Steffi Graf in the French Open first round since 1983.
Most popular visitor - Gabriela Sabatini, now retired but still only 27, who asked the organisers for an accreditation "just for the pleasure of being here."
Least favourite visitor - Marcelo Rios of Chile, awarded the "Prix Citron" by the media for the second consecutive year for his lack of co-operation.
